capabilities: Show status, title, day, and category from frontmatter in the file explorer
Set a workflow status on files via a picker, with multi-file support
Group and sort files by status, date, category, and title
Customize status colors and icons with CSS snippets
disambiguation: Not a task or habit tracker; it only decorates and sorts the file explorer using each note's frontmatter properties.
extras: Sorting and labels rely on undocumented internal APIs and may stop working after Obsidian updates, though the plugin fails safe. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only shows file names and offers no way to display frontmatter values or group files by a workflow status.
summary: File explorer enhancer that shows status, title, date, and category from frontmatter on file rows and sorts files by them.
